items.q: Garvan Bushell came into the band and so forth.

ctx.x: And baritone. That made up the reed section.

All right. What qualities did you look for in -- Or, did a musician have to have, because there wasn't much personnel changes. Garvan Bushell came into the band and so forth. But what qualities that you look for, say, between the first alto and the third alto?

Well, most of -- One time we had a thing called "a million dollar reed section." And I can tell you the qualities of he men that played in that band. We had a thing called a million dollar reed section. We would have like Foots Thomas, Hilton Jefferson, Chauncy Haughton -- maybe Waymon Carver. Maybe Waymon would come in on baritone.
